content.short: Brawler Bearz is a collectible RPG that uses dynamic and composable NFTs.
content.description: Dynamic and composable NFTs unlock a broad spectrum of use cases, with gaming taking a prominent role. Brawler Bearz NFTs support an ever-evolving character and asset gameplay while granting ownership rights to the buyer. The project also demonstrates cross-chain synchronization between Ethereum and Polygon, highlighting how layer-2 networks can deliver smoother interactions, faster updates, and a more cohesive UI/UX for players operating across chains.

resources.title: NFTs That Change After Minting
resources.tldr: The mechanic these bears are built on: metadata rewritten by contract logic, so equipment, XP and quest results show on the token itself.
